stock.description: Roiserv Lifestyle Services Co., Ltd. is a China-based enterprise providing a comprehensive range of property management services. Their core offerings include security, cleaning, landscaping, and general repair and maintenance. The company manages a diverse portfolio, covering residential properties, various non-residential complexes such as shopping malls, office buildings, and serviced apartments, alongside public and specialized facilities like industrial parks, schools, factories, and recreational venues. Beyond fundamental management, Roiserv assists property developers with services like property engineering, sales support, initial planning and design consultancy, property delivery, and after-sales care. For property owners and residents, they offer a suite of home-living solutions, including community retail, commercial procurement, home repairs and maintenance, and housekeeping. Their services also extend to property space management, notably turnkey furnishing, and property brokerage. Furthermore, the company engages in managing parking facilities, providing leasing options, operating and overseeing convenience stores, conducting online sales, and retailing a variety of commodities and food products. Established in 2000 as Langfang Rongsheng Property Service Co., Ltd., the company is headquartered in Langfang, China, and functions as a subsidiary of RiseSun Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.
